items.title: App Structure patlô
items.message: Abeipa ngiachhiena vata English-Mara Dictionary he May thla tawhta Hneithei awhpa ta theina rakha ta buakhei lymâ pa châta, Abeipa ngiachhiena vâta eima vaw patlô thei haw. A hmà tuhpa zydua English eima pahno na liata mia bao awpa nata khizaw thaina a so sâhna liata hma eima sie thei via nawpa ta, Nama vaw hmâ chyu awpa ta eimâ châ chaimâh.

items.title: Mara-English Dictionary chhao so pa achâ haw
items.message: Mara Dictionary lia he te Features thiepa so achhuah lymâ pa cha hrata, Zawpi zy chhao nama pachana mia vaw chho lyma awhpa ta eima cha haw.

items.title: Welcome to English - Mara Dictionary
items.message: Thank you for using the dictionary. Announcements and updates will appear here.
